name: Elliot Seeker
original_name: エリオット・シーカー
source:
[i]"Breaks are important too, right? Come on, let's hang out!"[/i]

[i]Cheerful Technician[/i]

The life of the party who loves tinkering with machines. He often reaches out to Leon, too, and is brushed off for his troubles. He aims to be a Sylphid to impress his younger brothers.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=elliot]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
